required_nodes.rationale: Real Ed25519 proves private custody through the production signer, durable claim, read-only trusted catalog, production verifier, and exact authenticated evidence.
Signer and custody key substitution fails before private material is retrieved.
Mappings and malformed principal objects cannot reach signing.
Missing, malformed, and wrong-key custody material fail closed with bounded errors.
Cryptographic backend and signing failures expose only fixed redacted reasons.
Each purpose-scoped operation reacquires and zeroizes custody material rather than caching it.
One root's provenance cannot authenticate a substituted root.
Structural proof excludes arbitrary-message signing, issuance, key/trust administration, allocation, admission, entitlement, effects, GenesisForge, and control-plane mutation.
The completed signer slice advances the exact current-facing next slice without implementing it.
The architecture marks purpose-scoped signing implemented while authority and allocation remain deferred.
